title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expression for the differential scattering cross section.

title: Scattering Angle
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly relate the incident angle to the deflected angle using the relationship alpha = 2*theta.

title: Impact Parameter
description: Important Criteria: The student must define the impact parameter as b = R*sin(theta) accurately.

title: Isotropic Nature
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain that the resulting cross section is independent of theta, confirming isotropy.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that the units of the cross section are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes or incorrect relationships between angles during derivation.
